title: CPU Spike Mitigation
description: Automated response to high CPU utilization on web servers

steps.name: Backup Current Configuration
steps.description: Create backup of existing nginx.conf

steps.name: Analyze CPU Usage Pattern
steps.description: Identify top processes and connection count
steps.command: top -bn1 | head -20; netstat -an | grep ESTABLISHED | wc -l
steps.validation: Parse top output and connection count

steps.name: Scale Worker Processes
steps.description: Increase nginx worker processes based on CPU cores

steps.name: Reload Nginx Service
steps.description: Gracefully reload nginx with new configuration
steps.validation: Check service status and error logs

steps.name: Verify Metrics Improvement
steps.description: Monitor CPU for 60s to confirm reduction
steps.command: for i in {1..6}; do top -bn1 | grep 'Cpu(s)' | awk '{print $2}'; sleep 10; done

steps.name: Update Monitoring Alert
steps.description: Log remediation in monitoring system

prerequisites: Root or sudo access on target server

title: RabbitMQ Queue Purge
description: Safely purge stale messages from RabbitMQ queues

steps.name: Queue Health Check
steps.description: Verify queue exists and check consumer count
steps.validation: Queue exists and has active consumers

steps.name: Backup Queue Messages
steps.description: Export messages to S3 for potential recovery

steps.name: Analyze Message Age
steps.description: Check message timestamps to identify stale messages

steps.name: Pause Consumers
steps.description: Temporarily pause consumers to prevent new message consumption

steps.name: Purge Queue
steps.description: Delete stale messages from queue

steps.name: Resume Consumers
steps.description: Re-enable message consumption

steps.name: Verify Queue Health
steps.description: Monitor queue for 30s to ensure normal operation
steps.command: watch -n 5 'rabbitmqctl list_queues name messages consumers message_stats'

rollback_steps: Can restore from S3 backup if absolutely necessary

risk_assessment.potential_impact: Stale messages permanently deleted (backed up to S3)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Messages backed up before purge, consumer pause prevents race conditions

title: Emergency Disk Space Recovery
description: Free up disk space by cleaning logs and temporary files

steps.name: Disk Usage Analysis
steps.description: Identify largest directories and files
steps.validation: Parse output to identify cleanup targets

steps.name: Create Cleanup Plan
steps.description: Calculate safe cleanup targets (>30 days old)
steps.command: find /var/log -type f -mtime +30 -exec ls -lh {} \; | awk '{sum+=$5} END {print sum}'

steps.name: Backup Critical Logs
steps.description: Archive important logs before deletion

steps.name: Compress Old Logs
steps.description: Compress logs older than 30 days

steps.name: Clean Temporary Files
steps.description: Remove temporary PostgreSQL query files

steps.name: Archive Old Backups
steps.description: Move backups older than 90 days to S3 Glacier

steps.name: Remove Archived Backups
steps.description: Delete local backups after S3 confirmation

steps.name: Verify Disk Space
steps.description: Confirm disk usage below threshold

prerequisites: AWS CLI configured for S3 access
rollback_steps: Retrieve backups from S3 if needed

risk_assessment.potential_impact: Old logs and backups removed (archived to S3)
risk_assessment.mitigation: All files backed up before deletion, S3 archive for 90-day retention

title: Blue-Green Deployment

steps.name: Deploy to Green Environment
steps.description: Deploy new version to inactive (green) environment
steps.command: kubectl set image deployment/api api=myapp:v2.3.1 -n prod-green
steps.validation: All pods running with new image

steps.name: Wait for Green Readiness
steps.description: Wait for all green pods to pass readiness checks

steps.name: Run Health Checks
steps.description: Verify all health endpoints in green environment
steps.command: for pod in $(kubectl get pods -n prod-green -o name); do kubectl exec -n prod-green $pod -- curl -f localhost:8080/health; done

steps.name: Run Smoke Tests
steps.description: Execute critical path smoke tests

steps.name: Switch Load Balancer
steps.description: Point load balancer to green environment
steps.rollback_impact: Traffic now flowing to new version

steps.name: Monitor Metrics
steps.description: Watch error rates and latency for 60s

steps.name: Drain Blue Environment
steps.description: Wait for existing connections to complete

prerequisites: New container image built and pushed
rollback_steps: Switch load balancer back to blue: kubectl patch service api-lb -n prod -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"environment":"blue"}}}'
Scale up blue environment if needed

risk_assessment.potential_impact: Brief traffic spike during LB switch (< 2s)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Blue environment kept running for instant rollback

title: Database Performance Tuning
description: Optimize PostgreSQL configuration for current workload

steps.name: Analyze Current Workload
steps.description: Check connection pool utilization and query patterns
steps.command: psql -c 'SELECT count(*) as connections FROM pg_stat_activity;'

steps.name: Backup Configuration
steps.description: Save current postgresql.conf

steps.name: Update Connection Pool
steps.description: Increase max_connections based on workload

steps.name: Update Shared Buffers
steps.description: Increase shared memory for better caching

steps.name: Reload PostgreSQL
steps.description: Apply new configuration (no downtime)

steps.name: Verify Configuration
steps.description: Confirm new settings applied

steps.name: Monitor Performance
steps.description: Watch connection pool and query performance

prerequisites: Sufficient system memory for increased buffers

title: Security Patch Deployment
description: Apply critical security patches across fleet

steps.name: Verify Patch Availability
steps.description: Check if security patch is available in repositories

steps.name: Create System Snapshot
steps.description: Snapshot current system state for rollback

steps.name: Update Package
steps.description: Install security patch

steps.name: Restart Dependent Services
steps.description: Restart services using the patched library

steps.name: Verify TLS Functionality
steps.description: Test TLS connections

steps.name: Run Security Scan
steps.description: Verify vulnerability patched

steps.name: Monitor Error Rates
steps.description: Watch for elevated error rates (2min)

risk_assessment.potential_impact: Service restarts cause brief connection drops, potential incompatibility
risk_assessment.mitigation: System snapshot enables full rollback, staged rollout recommended
